# Purpose
This file defines a syscall allowlist for a sandboxed process and ties each allowed call to a specific runtime need. It groups permissions for logging, HTTPS and HTTP socket use, DNS resolution, and OpenSSL key logging, and it restricts each syscall with argument checks such as file descriptor values, socket families, and socket options. The comments document why each syscall is needed, such as opening log files, sending DNS queries, waiting for TCP setup, or reading `/etc/hosts` and `/etc/resolv.conf`. It also includes process and timing calls such as `getpid`, `getrandom`, `sched_yield`, and `clock_nanosleep` to support OpenSSL randomness and scheduler control.
